datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a regular monthly schedule throughout 2022, classifying geographic areas in Haiti by food insecurity phase. The spatial data was compiled into monthly GeoJSON and KML files representing medium-term projections of acute food insecurity conditions.
